# unifi_access_door_group (Data Source)

Look up a UniFi Access door group by `id` (`unique_id`) or `name` (read-only). Use it to reference a door group that Terraform does not manage. **Modeled from the undocumented Access API and not yet verified against a live console — see the provider TODO.**



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Access object id (`unique_id`). Provide `id` or `name`.
- `name` (String) Door group display name. Provide `name` or `id`. If multiple groups share a name, the first match wins — look up by `id` to disambiguate.

### Read-Only

- `door_count` (Number) Number of member doors.
- `door_ids` (Set of String) Member door ids (`unique_id` of each door).
- `floor_count` (Number) Number of member floors.
- `group_type` (String) Grouping kind (e.g. `door`).
- `policy_count` (Number) Number of access policies referencing the group.
- `type` (String) Group type identifier.
